method: Human inspection of frozen HTML and wikitext, independently of new output; oracle_html_candidates.json is a whitespace-insensitive diagnostic locator, not accuracy scoring. Hidden ruby annotations, references and TextHover alternative text excluded in locator; blank-surface Ruby requires manual exception. Do not infer content correctness from line count or absence of needed.
sample_scope: 21 unique paired song pages: six-real 6 plus cached-check 15. Each has only one input revision here; no same-title different-revision comparison is collapsed. Most cached records have no revid: hashes identify frozen content, not inferred revision. All 21 song status independently supported by song introduction/lyrics, including human-sung 横竖撇点折. Person fallback must not be used as independent non-song oracle.
